role: Senior Embedded Software Developer / Embedded Software Engineer (m/f/d) C/C++ & RTOS

adjacent_skills.you_have: C++ / CUDA C++ (no modern-C++ idiom depth)
PyQt / PySide6 GUIs, OLED display driving

key_responsibilities: Develop hardware-related embedded applications on FreeRTOS/ThreadX for ARM Cortex-M
Design and implement backend functionality and software interfaces to subsystems and UIs in C and C++
Design and implement device and interface drivers (UART, USB, SPI, I2C)
Model and implement control algorithms for embedded systems
Contribute to embedded GUI implementation with TouchGFX, LVGL or uGFX
Run code reviews and enforce code quality and maintainability
Analyze and optimize runtime behaviour, memory requirements and system performance
Work agile on client projects with the customer embedded in the team (Jira, reviews, retros)

strengths: Bare-metal driver development on Cortex-M is concretely backed: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor programs GPIO, TIM2, ADC1 and a low-level I2C driver directly at register level, at 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM and a deterministic 1 Hz update rate - exactly the 'device and interface drivers' plus 'memory requirements' asks.

FreeRTOS on ARM Cortex-M is real, not a listing: Object Tracking Turret runs FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination on STM32, with interrupt-driven UART command handling and multi-servo PWM.

Control engineering is the strongest single match: Robocon holonomic drive derives heading from dual-axis quadrature encoder odometry (2400 CPR) and feeds angular error back into rotation PWM, with atan2 angle-weighted joystick-to-wheel mixing to kill PWM saturation - modelled and implemented control, not library calls.

Hardware interfaces span the JD list with working evidence: UART Jetson-to-STM32 bridge, I2C via TCA9548A mux and VL53L0X ToF, SPI in the embedded stack, USB Host Shield for Xbox control, plus BLE/Classic.
Circuit-diagram and EE understanding exceeds what a software req usually needs: custom single-layer PCBs fabricated in EAGLE, Proteus verification, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
Git and Linux-based development are solid: GitLab version control, systemd unit files with auto-restart and non-root isolation, static IP networking, XRDP administration of a headless Jetson.

Interrupt-driven, from-first-principles firmware work recurs across projects (4-bit A/B quadrature state machine on hardware interrupts, 15 kHz PWM via DuePWM, fail-safe state machine on controller disconnect).
real_gaps: Modern C++ (C++11/14/17) - C++ appears only as two-link IK on Arduino and CUDA C++ kernels; nothing in the profile evidences STL, RAII, templates, or object-oriented application/backend design in C++.
Embedded GUI frameworks (TouchGFX, LVGL, uGFX) - the closest evidence is an OLED distance display and PySide6/PyQt desktop GUIs, which is a different discipline from embedded graphics on Cortex-M.
Unit testing, static code analysis and continuous integration - no test suite, no linting/analysis tooling, no CI pipeline anywhere in the profile.
USB as a designed interface/driver (device classes, stacks) - USB shows up only as host-side Xbox controller input.
JTAG/SWD debugger-driven analysis - measurement tools are listed (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) but no debug-probe workflow, watchpoints or trace analysis is evidenced.

Senior-level scope: 0 years full-time professional development, 7 internships, no billable client-project delivery or ownership of a shipped production embedded product - the JD centres on senior ownership inside client projects.
Agile delivery practice (Scrum/Kanban, Jira on client engagements) - team leadership is evidenced, formal agile ceremonies are not.
overstated_by_keywords: Modern C++ - counted as Adjacent off 'C/C++' and 'CUDA C++', but the JD wants 'very good knowledge of modern C++' for application and backend logic, which the profile does not demonstrate.

Performance optimization - the strong numbers (5.2x TensorRT, 1.5-2x CUDA kernels, 35% coalescing gain) are GPU-side; embedded runtime/footprint optimization is evidenced only by the 3.68 KB Flash temperature monitor.
Embedded GUI counted as Adjacent - PyQt/PySide6 and an OLED readout do not transfer to TouchGFX/LVGL widget, framebuffer and rendering work.

System integration counted as Have at senior scope - COFFIN integration is real (11 failures resolved, 100% pick reliability) but it is capstone scope, not architecture ownership across a client product.
understated_by_keywords: Control algorithm design and implementation - the keyword pass sees 'Closed-Loop Feedback Control' as one term, but Robocon shows derived odometry-based heading correction, atan2 mixing derivation, and 4-bit quadrature decoding written from first principles.
Memory-constrained firmware engineering - an explicit 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM figure directly answers the JD's 'optimize memory requirements' ask and no keyword captures it.

Hardware bring-up and debugging judgement - 11 documented integration failures (false positives, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) resolved end to end, which is the analysis skill the debugging bullet is really screening for.
Cross-compilation and toolchain work is implicit in every STM32/Arduino/Jetson build but never named as a skill.
screening_gaps: Senior-level track record: the title and the 'Senior Software Developer (m/f/d) Application (RTOS)' framing means billable client-project seniority, and the profile has 0 years full-time - this is the first filter a German consultancy applies.
Modern C++ depth: the req names C and modern C++ as the core programming ask, and the profile cannot defend C++11/14/17 idiom, STL or OO embedded application design under a technical screen.
Embedded GUI plus the QA stack (TouchGFX/LVGL, unit tests, static analysis, CI): four listed asks with no backing at all, and the GUI integration bullet is a named responsibility, not a nice-to-have.
llm_analysis.reasoning: On skill and domain fit this is one of the closer embedded reqs in the funnel: FreeRTOS on Cortex-M, register-level driver work, the full UART/SPI/I2C interface set, real control-algorithm derivation, PCB/schematic literacy and Linux/Git are all concretely backed. The gaps are narrow but they sit exactly where the JD puts weight - modern C++ for application and backend logic, embedded GUI frameworks, and the test/static-analysis/CI discipline a service provider sells to clients. Worth an application because the technical core genuinely overlaps and Gilching is a Blue Card shortage-occupation market with up to 80% remote, but expect the senior framing and the C++ depth probe to be where it is decided.
